name: Tenshi-tachi no Gogo Special 2
source:
Main hero is high school student but he also steals money and assets from villains to return it to the proper owners. One day he received a request by mail to get "Blue Diamond" out of debt situation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-may-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名高中生，同时也会从恶徒手中盗走钱财与资产，将其归还给真正的主人。一天，他收到一封委托信，请他帮助“蓝钻石”摆脱债务困境。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-may-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
